description: 95-135ms capture. Best for visual layout validation, canvas/image inspection. For multimodal models only. Text-only models should use browser_map or browser_canvas instead.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

clip.description: Clip region. Use to capture only part of the page (e.g. just a chart area) to reduce token cost.

format.description: Capture format. 'jpeg' is smaller and faster for large pages. Default 'png'.

fullPage.description: If true, captures the full scrollable page. Default false (viewport only).

quality.description: JPEG quality 0-100 (default 90). Only used when format is jpeg.

selector.description: CSS selector of an element to crop the capture to (its bounding rect).

name: browser_screenshot
